qualification:
Derive reference-prefix admission facts from actual native decoder entry.
No owned reference or SDK model stubs execute. These facts plus independently
checked byte frames/actual scan transport can construct the emitted reference
prefix, avoiding a second full SDK execution in the same solver target.
domain: Same full arbitrary fixed-root buffers/SDK metadata/Rc counters/aliases as shared-prefix harness. Native only; no owned reference loaded or executed. Native source prefix hash is unchanged.
remaining: All properties and covers must pass. Actual std scan=false/all-zero transport and initial-byte preservation are independent checked boundaries, not assumed here. Need explicit reference-prefix construction and source/cut transport, then successful child/guard/gate/writeback/runtime/oracle composition. No full stage1 or S2 closure.
unreachable_cuts: Both native/owned first_decoded and actual validator/encoder receive assert-false panic cuts, not successful replies. Every cut reachability/safety assertion must pass. This removes statically retained verifier/arithmetic bodies from frame instrumentation; it does not assume their unreachability.
input_constructor: Pinned Kani library vec::exact_vec<u8,N>: Box::new(any<[u8;N]>()) followed by boxed-slice into_vec; every input byte remains independently arbitrary. No buffer byte is fixed, left uninitialized, or assumed. Native source, model, assertions and enforced write set are unchanged.
error_assertions: Constructor-complete matches replace derived ProgramError/Result PartialEq/Debug assertions in the proof harness only. Both results must be exactly Err(InvalidAccountData), preserving full status equality at this decoder-error cut; no payload/error/state premise is removed. Frozen SDK/caller and complete reference bodies, input domains and enforced native frame are unchanged.
